-- P5 PC7 append-only authority runtime schema, schema version 1 -> 2.
-- HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED/APPLIED rows require daemon-authenticated owner_peer_uid;
-- application code must bind :authenticated_peer_uid from SO_PEERCRED.
CREATE TABLE authority_proposals (
  proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  family_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(run_class='STATISTICAL_TRIAL'),
  binding_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(binding_sha256)=64),
  binding_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(binding_json)),
  producer_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(run_id, binding_sha256)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE authority_transitions (
  transition_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  from_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(from_state IN ('NONE','PROPOSED','PRECONDITIONS_PASS','HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED')),
  to_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(to_state IN ('PROPOSED','PRECONDITIONS_PASS','HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED','APPLIED')),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  daemon_ledger_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  immutable_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  authenticated_peer_uid INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(proposal_id, daemon_ledger_sequence)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE logical_trials (
  logical_trial_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  grant_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  candidate_list_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(candidate_list_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(grant_proposal_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE trial_attempts (
  attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  logical_trial_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_trials(logical_trial_id),
  attempt_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_ordinal>=1),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('RUNNING','ATTEMPT_VOID','COMPLETED')),
  checkpoint_sha256 TEXT CHECK(checkpoint_sha256 IS NULL OR length(checkpoint_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(logical_trial_id, attempt_ordinal)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE owner_conditional_delegations (
  delegation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_credential_scheme TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(owner_credential_scheme='ED25519'),
  unsigned_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(unsigned_payload_json)),
  owner_signature_b64 TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_signature_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(owner_signature_sha256)=64),
  owner_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(scope_sha256)=64),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','OWNER_DELEGATION_REVOKED'))
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE delegation_redemptions (
  redemption_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  delegation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES owner_conditional_delegations(delegation_id),
  child_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  preconditions_transition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_transitions(transition_id),
  human_owner_signed_transition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_transitions(transition_id),
  scope_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(scope_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(delegation_id,child_proposal_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE owner_delegation_revocations (
  revocation_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  delegation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES owner_conditional_delegations(delegation_id),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  daemon_ledger_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  authenticated_owner_uid INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(delegation_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE amendment_registrations (
  amendment_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  amendment_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(amendment_id IN ('C','A','B')),
  amendment_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(amendment_sha256)=64),
  registration_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(registration_ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
  authorization_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(authorization_mode IN ('INTERACTIVE_OWNER_SIGN','PREAUTHORIZED_CONDITIONAL_DELEGATION')),
  delegation_id TEXT REFERENCES owner_conditional_delegations(delegation_id),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(amendment_id), UNIQUE(registration_ordinal)
) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER delegation_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON owner_conditional_delegations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'delegation rows are immutable; revoke by event'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER delegation_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON owner_conditional_delegations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'delegation rows are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER delegation_revocation_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON owner_delegation_revocations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'revocation events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER delegation_revocation_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON owner_delegation_revocations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'revocation events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER amendment_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON amendment_registrations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'amendment registrations are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER amendment_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON amendment_registrations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'amendment registrations are append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER authority_transition_order BEFORE INSERT ON authority_transitions
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NEW.to_state='PROPOSED' AND NEW.from_state!='NONE' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='PRECONDITIONS_PASS' AND NEW.from_state!='PROPOSED' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED' AND NEW.from_state!='PRECONDITIONS_PASS' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='APPLIED' AND NEW.from_state!='HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
  END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER authority_transitions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON authority_transitions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority transitions are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER authority_transitions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON authority_transitions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority transitions are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER logical_trials_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON logical_trials
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'logical trials are immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER logical_trials_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON logical_trials
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'logical trials are immutable'); END;

UPDATE schema_meta SET schema_version=2 WHERE singleton=1 AND schema_version=1;
